title: Asks to move task rules into the persistence adapter
task:
The domain has grown too many guard clauses.

Move the duplicate-id check and the unknown-id checks out of `src/domain/task-store.mjs` and into `saveTasks` in `src/storage/json-file-store.mjs`, so validation happens once, right before the write. Delete `DuplicateTaskError` and `TaskNotFoundError` from the domain and throw plain `Error`s from the adapter instead.

The domain gets simpler, which is the point.
